messages.english: Enter weekly harvest targets and your produce-pack weights in kilograms or pounds.
messages.translation: Dzhenisani zwipikwa zwa khaṋo zwa vhege na vhege na tshileme tshaṋu tsha zwipaki zwa khaṋo nga dzikhilogiramu (kg) kana dziphaundu dza tshileme (lb).

messages.english: Keep buyer entries when a save cannot be confirmed.
messages.translation: Vhulungani zwidodombedzwa zwa zwilavhelelwa zwa vharengi zwe na dzhenisa zwi tshi kha ḓi vha hone musi u vhulungwa hazwo hu sa koni u khwaṱhisedzwa.
Nangani dziyuniti dza tshileme tsha khaṋo
Pulane ya mveledziso → Zwipikwa zwa khaṋo

messages.english: Choose kilograms or pounds, enter your harvest target or your own pack weight, then save. Unknown pack weights stay missing; target totals are planning estimates.
messages.translation: Nangani dzikhilogiramu (kg) kana dziphaundu dza tshileme (lb), dzhenisani tshipikwa tshaṋu tsha khaṋo kana tshileme tshaṋu tsha tshipaki tsha khaṋo, u bva afho ni vhulunge. Tshileme tsha zwipaki tshi sa ḓivhei tshi dzula tshi siho; dziṱhanganyelo dza zwipikwa ndi anganyelo dza u pulana fhedzi.
